chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said regarding the woman: if she commits adultery before the man has had sexual intercourse with her, they are separated, and she is not entitled to her dower, because the incident was from her.

key_terms.يَدْخُلَ بِهَا: had sexual intercourse with her / consummated the marriage

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a woman's dowry if she commits adultery before marital consummation?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi, tracing back to Imam al-Sadiq (AS) and Imam Ali (AS), establishes the principle of 'al-hadath min qibaliha' (the fault lies with her) in pre-consummation marital separation. It highlights the Shia juristic view that the wife's breach of sexual fidelity before consummation voids her claim to the dower, distinguishing it from cases where the husband initiates the separation. This ruling underscores the importance of chastity as a condition for retaining marital rights in early Shia legal theory.
